summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 21 (VAD-triggered flush for Whisper windows) is genuinely compiled into this rebuilt installer, with zero regression to every prior-phase Rust symbol.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 21's own commit) the Phase 21 rebuild was performed against. Phase 21 touches core/ai/src/speech_engine.rs, ai/speech/src/whisper.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/state.rs, apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs, apps/desktop/src/config/appConfig.ts, and apps/desktop/src/components/workspace/PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx.
buildLog: ran via a background task this session (not committed - ephemeral build log)

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done (now a 15th consecutive rebuild).

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresResult: All 19 counts identical to the Phase 20 baseline - zero regression. whisper_full_with_state stable at 96 for a 15th consecutive rebuild (Phase 7.3 through Phase 21).
symbolRegressionCheck.priorPhaseNote: Every prior-phase symbol checked, including Phase 17's own Detection Accuracy Analytics functions and Phase 20's own fuzzy_match_book/canonicalize_book, remains present and unregressed.

newSymbolsThisPhase.note: last_feed_was_vad_early_flush (the new SpeechEngine trait method's own name) is directly confirmed present. should_flush_early/has_trailing_pause were inlined by the release-mode optimizer, as expected for small pure functions each called from exactly one site - consistent with this project's own established precedent (e.g. fuzzy_match_book's own internal levenshtein/max_allowed_distance helpers in Phase 20, ordinal_value in Phase 19). vad_early_flushes is a plain struct field name/counter, not a function - its absence from the symbol table is expected and unrelated to whether the counter itself works, which is proven instead by the full test suite plus the direct presence of last_feed_was_vad_early_flush, the function that decides its value.

frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe the same way Rust symbols are - the new vadEarlyFlushes field and its PilotDiagnosticsPanel.tsx rendering were not independently string-searched, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness rests on npm run typecheck's success and the full 303/303 frontend test pass (unchanged from Phase 20, since this phase's frontend change is purely additive - a new diagnostic field and one new conditional render line).
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations, zero schema changes.
The fixed CHUNK_SAMPLES (3s) hard cap is unchanged and checked first - VAD-triggered flush is strictly additive (an earlier opportunity to flush), never a removal of the existing latency bound.
run_inference itself (the code that talks to whisper.cpp, computes timestamps, and applies the silence/placeholder gates) is untouched - only the decision of when to call it changed.
Every other domain contract crate (core/bible, core/sermon, core/music, core/presentation) is entirely untouched.
Every prior-phase command and Phase 14-20 symbol remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's addition did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
environmentCStatus: Not yet performed. A real operator running a live service and confirming (a) the new vadEarlyFlushes diagnostic counter rises during normal speech with natural pauses, and (b) transcript quality at sentence boundaries subjectively improves compared to the pre-Phase-21 fixed-3s-window behavior, is required to close Environment C for this phase.
